subject.title: Support Docs smart chips in cat output

question: Should `gog docs cat` use this opt-in `--chips` flag plus additive JSON fields as the accepted smart-chip readback contract?
rationale: The linked issue was already routed as needing a script-visible output contract decision, and this PR adds a new flag plus JSON fields without visible maintainer confirmation yet.

options.title: Accept opt-in/additive contract
options.body: Proceed with the compatibility-preserving `--chips` flag and additive JSON fields after the contributor fixes numbered output and adds live smart-chip proof.

options.title: Prefer default rendering
options.body: Ask for chips to render in existing text fields by default, accepting the script-visible behavior change as intentional.

options.title: Defer product surface
options.body: Pause or close this PR until maintainers choose a different Docs readback contract.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in/additive contract
recommendation.body: Proceed with the compatibility-preserving `--chips` flag and additive JSON fields after the contributor fixes numbered output and adds live smart-chip proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to both the current Docs read extractor and the merged smart-chip insertion surface in git history.
